22379_hakka.concern: 発火点 is the ignition point (autoignition temperature); 'flash point' is 引火点, a different concept. Equating them would mislead a learner.
22379_hakka.suggestion: Change to '発火点: ignition point (autoignition temperature)' and, if desired, mention that flash point is 引火点.
22379_hakka.quote: 発火点: ignition point / flash point
